header.title: Support for every step
header.subtitle: From individual therapy to community workshops, we offer a full range of mental health programs.

items.title: Individual Therapy
items.description: One-on-one sessions with licensed counselors tailored to your personal needs and goals.

items.title: Group Counseling
items.description: Guided group sessions where members share experiences and build community support.

items.title: Crisis Helpline
items.description: Confidential, round-the-clock phone support for anyone in emotional distress.

items.title: Family Therapy
items.description: Structured sessions that help families communicate and heal together.

items.title: Teen Support Program
items.description: A safe space designed specifically for adolescents navigating mental health challenges.

items.title: Support Groups & Workshops
items.description: Regular workshops on mindfulness, stress management, and emotional resilience.

items.title: Tele-Counseling
items.description: Secure video sessions for those who prefer or need to connect remotely.

steps.title: Reach Out
steps.description: Contact us by phone, email, or our online form — no referral needed.

steps.title: Assessment
steps.description: A gentle, judgment-free conversation to understand your situation.

steps.title: Personalized Plan
steps.description: We match you with the right counselor and care plan for your needs.

steps.title: Ongoing Support
steps.description: Regular sessions and check-ins as you continue your healing journey.
